defects.contract: An explicitly configured StoragePath is used by FileStore.
defects.acceptance: Enqueue persists a snapshot at the caller-supplied path.

defects.contract: Invalid JSON is rejected.
defects.acceptance: Malformed configuration JSON returns a non-nil error.

defects.contract: Callbacks may unsubscribe while receiving an event.
defects.acceptance: Publishing completes when a callback invokes its unsubscribe function.

defects.contract: Equal-priority jobs are FIFO.
defects.acceptance: The first equal-priority enqueue is dequeued first.

defects.contract: Higher priority work reaches queue consumers first.
defects.acceptance: A higher-priority job is dequeued before a lower-priority job.

defects.contract: Dequeue blocks until work, closure, or context cancellation.
defects.acceptance: An empty Dequeue returns the context deadline rather than ErrEmpty.

defects.contract: Close wakes blocked producers.
defects.acceptance: A producer blocked on capacity returns ErrClosed promptly after Close.

defects.contract: Retry index zero uses BaseDelay.
defects.acceptance: Delay(0) equals BaseDelay.

defects.contract: Retry index maxAttempts is not eligible.
defects.acceptance: ShouldRetry(maxAttempts, maxAttempts) is false.

defects.contract: Backoff never exceeds MaxDelay.
defects.acceptance: Large retry indexes return exactly MaxDelay.

defects.contract: Atomic replacement failures reach the caller.
defects.acceptance: Saving over an incompatible target returns an error.

defects.contract: Corrupt snapshots are not treated as empty state.
defects.acceptance: Malformed snapshot JSON returns an error.

defects.contract: Readers are closed on failed decoding.
defects.acceptance: A tracked corrupt snapshot reader has Close invoked.

defects.contract: Recovery preserves queue ordering.
defects.acceptance: Saved first/second jobs load as first/second.

defects.contract: Retry durations cross module boundaries without unit conversion.
defects.acceptance: A 100ms retry is not due after 1ms.

defects.contract: A scheduler has one ticker loop.
defects.acceptance: Second Start returns ErrStarted.

defects.contract: Stop releases the ticker resource.
defects.acceptance: The ticker Stop method is called.

defects.contract: NextDaily retains caller location across DST.
defects.acceptance: NextDaily result keeps the supplied location.

defects.contract: Cancellation prevents delayed retry enqueue.
defects.acceptance: No retry is enqueued after Pool.Stop.

defects.contract: Stop waits for outstanding retry work.
defects.acceptance: Stop observes the caller deadline while a retry remains outstanding.

defects.contract: Ack rejects IDs not in flight.
defects.acceptance: Ack of an unknown ID returns ErrUnknownJob.

defects.contract: Acknowledgement observers see the job in flight.
defects.acceptance: An acknowledgement callback observes InFlight equal to one.

defects.contract: Utilization is queued divided by capacity.
defects.acceptance: One queued job in capacity four reports utilization 0.25.
